== FIX DIRECTION (true emoji) ==
All true-emoji occurrences are FUNCTIONAL ICONS (button labels / type glyphs), NOT decorative — none can be plain-deleted; each needs a real replacement. Replace with Flash 8-appropriate inline SVG glyphs (preferred) or a neutral monochrome text/dingbat glyph per docs/30-flash8-ui-spec.md. Specifically:
  - 👁 (show/hide all)    -> eye SVG or reuse the per-row visibility glyph convention
  - 🔒/🔓 (lock states)   -> padlock SVG (closed/open); keep the locked/unlocked distinction. NOTE the per-layer Lock column already uses "•" for unlocked and 🔒 for locked — pick ONE padlock representation and apply consistently (header all-lock L1264, per-row L1457, and PropertiesPanel aspect lock L906).
  - 📁 (folder)          -> folder SVG; used in 2 places (layer-type glyph L1374 + Insert-Folder footer button L1817) — share one glyph.
  - 🗑 (delete layer)    -> trash SVG (or a neutral "Delete"/x glyph consistent with the other footer buttons).
Keep the existing `title` attributes (tooltips) intact; only swap the visible glyph.
